title: Conditional κ = 0.001679754956125544: fine source-prime padding (PR1786) at the free epsilon -> 1 point, with gauge-free interiors and the radix-distributed union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769983114385025802954603273198268490086748910957328658012158594**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below, with fine source-prime padding (PR1786, chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa, via Tim Trudgian's prime theorem; vendored) which makes the grouped chirp guard beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1, the fractional-shift gauge-free interiors with accretive shallow circuits (PR1758, outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md), the radix-distributed union schedule with per-visit tag work, and the explicit Strassen boundary. New here: epsilon is a free parameter of the PR1786 ledger (every row holds for every 1-epsilon > 1e-64), so the explicit point is epsilon = 1 - 2e-64, beta = 1 - 6e-64, giving kappa = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257..., 3.4e-67 below the supplier's complex saving q, hence the ceiling of any outer of this form (outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md). 57 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, an independent balance derivation with an epsilon sweep, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and the gauge-free identity checks are regenerated; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses and the cited prime theorem; the fine-padding lemmas (PR1786 is a draft) and the composition need independent review; asymptotic margins are 2e-64.

Conditional kappa 0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769983114385025802954603273198268490086748910957328658012158594 (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-2e-64, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md).
